children: Gideon joins from Flipkart, where she most recently served as Vice President – Corporate Affairs and Head – Corporate Communications and CSR

Tech Mahindra has appointed Sarah Gideon as Global Head – Corporate Communications & Public Affairs, bringing her on board to lead the technology major’s global corporate communications and public affairs mandate.
Gideon joins Tech Mahindra after a six-year stint at Flipkart, where she most recently served as Vice President – Corporate Affairs and Head – Corporate Communications and CSR.

In her new role, Gideon will oversee corporate communications and public affairs across Tech Mahindra’s global markets. Her mandate will span corporate narrative, reputation management and engagement with key stakeholder groups.
Gideon brings extensive experience in corporate communications and reputation management, with a career spanning leading technology and digital organisations.

Before joining Flipkart, she spent more than a decade at Infosys, where she headed corporate communications. Throughout her career, she has worked across corporate reputation, leadership communications, and stakeholder engagement, as well as communications for large, complex organisations.
Her appointment comes as Tech Mahindra strengthens its global communications and public affairs function amid an increasingly complex stakeholder and corporate reputation landscape.
